sequence_length.description: An integer representing the sequence length.

sequence_stride.description: An integer representing the sequence hop size.

fft_length.description: An integer representing the size of the FFT to apply. If not specified, uses the smallest power of 2 enclosing `sequence_length`.

window.description: A string, a tensor of the window or `None`. If `window` is a string, available values are `"hann"` and `"hamming"`. If `window` is a tensor, it will be used directly as the window and its length must be `sequence_length`. If `window` is `None`, no windowing is used. Defaults to `"hann"`.
constraints: window must be one of hann, hamming

center.description: Whether to pad `x` on both sides so that the t-th sequence is centered at time `t * sequence_stride`. Otherwise, the t-th sequence begins at time `t * sequence_stride`. Defaults to `True`.

output.description: A tuple containing two tensors - the real and imaginary parts of the STFT output.
